initial64_additive_floor.proof: On this finite set, allow an independent unrestricted value for A at each unique left input and B at each unique right input. This contains every shared deterministic additive model on the set. Global linear least squares therefore gives the exact class minimum empirical RMSE, irrespective of nonlinear function forms or parameter fitting.

independent_analytic_certificate.proof: For additive predictions, the signed four-group contrast is zero. Cauchy-Schwarz gives sum of four squared mean residuals >= observed contrast squared/4. Six repetitions per group imply SSE >= 6*contrast^2/4, before adding within-group noise or other records.
